thermal_cycler.conventions: `lid_closed` interlock on the run action; `robot_access_ready`; a run action that is `cancellable`
thermal_cycler.label: thermal cycler
thermal_cycler.definition: An instrument that is capable of repeatedly altering and maintaining specific temperatures for defined periods of time.

liquid_handler.conventions: `robot_access_ready`; positions named as the vendor names them in `notes`
liquid_handler.label: liquid handler
liquid_handler.definition: A device that is used for automated liquid transfer and handling.

robot_arm.conventions: a `locations` map; `robot_access_ready` on anything it serves
robot_arm.label: Robot
robot_arm.definition: A mechanical device that sometimes resembles a living animal and is capable of performing a variety of often complex human tasks on command or by being programmed in advance.

stage.conventions: a `locations` map; `robot_access_ready` on anything it serves
stage.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

microscope.conventions: an `acquire` action returning an image URI in `returns`
microscope.label: microscope
microscope.definition: A microscope is a device which is used to visually magnify a specimen. [Allotrope]

electron_microscope.conventions: `vacuum_ready`, `beam_on`, `stage_position` signals; `load_sample` with `robot_access_ready` and `physical.automated_load`; `acquire_image` whose `returns` names the file and magnification; e-stop turns the beam off
electron_microscope.label: electron microscope
electron_microscope.definition: A piece of apparatus which is used to produce an enlarged image of a specimen using a finely focused (<10 nm diameter) electron beam with an acceleration voltage of 50–150 kV under vacuum and measuring the interaction of the electrons with the specimen.

camera.conventions: an `acquire` action returning an image URI in `returns`
camera.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

sampler.conventions: `robot_access_ready`; positions named as the vendor names them in `notes`
sampler.label: sampler
sampler.definition: A sample is a device that function to sample known amounts of material. [Allotrope]

chromatograph.conventions: one method-driven run action (`methods: true`, SPEC 4.5) whose `returns` names the result file or table; `usage_count` counts injections
chromatograph.label: chromatograph
chromatograph.definition: A piece of apparatus, consisting of a mobile phase supply system, an injection or sampling system, a column, detector and a data acquisition/processing system, that is used to carry out chromatographic separations. [CHMO]

mass_spectrometer.conventions: one method-driven run action whose `returns` names the result file; `usage_count` counts scans or runs
mass_spectrometer.label: mass spectrometer
mass_spectrometer.definition: A mass spectrometer is a measurement device that measures the m/z values and abundances of gas-phase ions. [IUPAC]

nuclear_magnetic_resonance_spectrometer.conventions: one method-driven run action whose `returns` names the result folder; `usage_count` counts experiments
nuclear_magnetic_resonance_spectrometer.label: nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer
nuclear_magnetic_resonance_spectrometer.definition: A nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer is a measurement device used to conduct NMR experiments consisting of a magnet housing a sample space surrounded by two coils which act to transmit radio frequency radiation to the sample and to detect the response of the sample. [CHMO]

diffractometer.conventions: one method-driven scan action whose `returns` names the pattern file; `usage_count` counts scans
diffractometer.label: diffractometer
diffractometer.definition: A piece of apparatus which illuminates a sample with X-rays, electrons or neutrons and measures the diffraction pattern produced. It typically will contain at least one monochromator to ensure the incident radiation is of a specific energy, a goniometer which allows the geometry of the sample and detector to be precisely specified, and a detector.

thermal_analyzer.conventions: one method-driven run action (DSC, TGA) whose `returns` names the result file; `usage_count` counts runs
thermal_analyzer.label: differential scanning calorimeter
thermal_analyzer.definition: A device that is used to measure the heat of chemical reactions or physical changes for both a sample and a reference. [CHMO]

microplate_reader.conventions: one protocol-driven read action whose `returns` names the result table; `robot_access_ready` when the tray is out
microplate_reader.label: microplate reader
microplate_reader.definition: A measurement device that detects biological, chemical or physical events of samples in microtiter plates.

dissolution_tester.conventions: a run action with typed media, speed and sampling times and `returns` naming the sample table; `usage_count` counts runs
dissolution_tester.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

capillary_electrophoresis_instrument.conventions: one method-driven run action whose `returns` names the result file; `usage_count` counts injections
capillary_electrophoresis_instrument.label: capillary electrophoresis instrument
capillary_electrophoresis_instrument.definition: An electrophoresis system that is used to separate ionic species by their charge and frictional forces and mass.

real_time_pcr_machine.conventions: one plate-run action whose `returns` names the result export; `lid_closed` interlock; `usage_count` counts runs
real_time_pcr_machine.label: real-time PCR machine
real_time_pcr_machine.definition: An PCR instrument that enables both detection and quantification of one or more specific sequences in a DNA sample.

flow_cytometer.conventions: one acquisition action whose `returns` names the FCS files; `usage_count` counts tubes or wells
flow_cytometer.label: flow cytometer
flow_cytometer.definition: A piece of apparatus, consisting of a flow cell, a laser and a detector, which detects the fluorescence and light scattering of individual particles (e.g. cells).

spectrometer.conventions: an `acquire` action with typed integration time whose `returns` carries the spectrum or names its file
spectrometer.label: spectrometer
spectrometer.definition: A piece of apparatus used to measure a spectrum. [CHMO]

particle_analyzer.conventions: measurements as signals with units; a `measure` action whose `returns` carries the size distribution summary
particle_analyzer.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

biosensor.conventions: measurements as signals with units; `out_of_spec` from the instrument's self-check where it has one
biosensor.label: biosensor
biosensor.definition: A chemosensor that recognises the analyte under study by interaction with a given biological system.

cell_counter.conventions: measurements as signals with units; a `count` action whose `returns` carries concentration and viability
cell_counter.label: cell counter
cell_counter.definition: A device used to count the number of cells present in known volume of sample to determine the overall concentration cells per unit volume. [Allotrope]

profilometer.conventions: a `scan` action with typed length and force whose `returns` names the profile file and the step height
profilometer.label: profilometer
profilometer.definition: A piece of apparatus that measures surface profiles by dragging a (diamond) stylus across the sample surface. A feedback loop is used to maintain a fixed relationship between the stylus and surface during scanning.

surface_analyzer.conventions: a method-driven acquisition whose `returns` names the spectrum or image; vacuum readiness as a signal and interlock
surface_analyzer.label: X-ray photoelectron spectrometer
surface_analyzer.definition: A piece of apparatus, consisting of an X-ray source, an analyser and a detector, which is used to measure the photoelectron emission of samples bombarded with X-rays.

rheometer.conventions: measured and setpoint temperature as separate signals; a method-driven run action whose `returns` names the result file; `lid_closed` interlock
rheometer.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

mechanical_tester.conventions: `load`, `extension` and `crosshead_state` signals; `run_test` with typed rate and limits whose `returns` carries peak load and modulus; e-stop halts the crosshead; `hardware_stop: true`
mechanical_tester.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

balance.conventions: `weigh` returning `{mass, unit, stable}`; `tare`; `calibration_status` from the instrument's own log where it has one
balance.label: balance
balance.definition: A balance is a weighing device, intended predominantly for medium to low capacity weighments, with moderate to high resolutions, mostly used indoors. [Allotrope]

dispenser.conventions: a `dose` action with typed target mass and tolerance whose `returns` carries the dispensed mass; `calibration_status` from the balance
dispenser.label: Dispenser
dispenser.definition: A container designed to give out the contents in convenient or/and prescribed amounts.

pump.conventions: `flow`/`pressure` signals in UCUM; a `stop` that zeroes the setpoint; `estop: true`
pump.label: pump
pump.definition: A pump is a device that is used to pump. [CHMO]

mass_flow_controller.conventions: `flow`/`pressure` signals in UCUM; a `stop` that zeroes the setpoint; `estop: true`
mass_flow_controller.label: mass flow controller
mass_flow_controller.definition: A mass flow controller is a device that determines the mixture of different materials. [Allotrope]

valve.conventions: position as a setting with the vendor's names; `estop` leaves the valve where it is unless `safety.notes` says otherwise
valve.label: valve
valve.definition: A valve is a plumbing equipment that regulates, directs or controls the flow of a fluid (gases, liquids, fluidized solids, or slurries) by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways. [Wikipedia]

titrator.conventions: one method-driven titration whose `returns` carries the result and its unit; `usage_count` counts titrations
titrator.label: titrator
titrator.definition: A titrator is a device that automates titrations. [Allotrope]

hotplate.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `estop` turns heating and stirring off
hotplate.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

stirrer.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `estop` stops the motor
stirrer.label: stirrer
stirrer.definition: A stirrer is a mixing device used for stirring something. [Allotrope]

circulator.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `circulating` as a signal
circulator.label: water bath
circulator.definition: A water bath is a temperature control bath in which a water acts as contact medium enabling temperature transfer from the heating element or cooling element to the sample. The temperature can be controlled in the 0 to 100 degree centigrade range (under normal pressure).

temperature_controller.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals per loop
temperature_controller.label: temperature controller
temperature_controller.definition: A device used to control the temperature in a compartment. [Allotrope]

incubator.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `door_closed` as a signal and an interlock; `robot_access_ready` where a handling system loads it
incubator.label: incubator
incubator.definition: A device in which environmental conditions (light, photoperiod, temperature, humidity, etc.) can be controlled

oven.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `door_closed` as a signal and an interlock
oven.label: oven
oven.definition: An oven is a device for heating an enclosed space. [Allotrope]

furnace.conventions: `temperature` and `temperature_setpoint` separate; `program_running` and `segment` signals; `run_program` with typed `segments` (target, ramp, dwell) and `returns`; `door_closed` interlock; watchdog `release`, because an abort mid-sinter is the damage
furnace.label: Furnace Device
furnace.definition: An enclosed chamber designed to produce heat.

environmental_chamber.conventions: temperature and humidity measured and setpoint as separate signals; `door_closed` as a signal and an interlock
environmental_chamber.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

glovebox.conventions: `o2_ppm`, `h2o_ppm`, `box_pressure` signals; `antechamber_state` enum; `antechamber_cycle` with a typed purge count; inner and outer door actions interlocked on each other; `robot_access_ready` only when the inner door is open and the box is still
glovebox.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

shaker.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `lid_closed` interlock; `robot_access_ready` where a handling system loads it
shaker.label: incubator shaker
shaker.definition: An incubating device that provides shaking motion for biomedical applications (e.g., cell cultures).

centrifuge.conventions: `lid_closed` interlock on the run action; `robot_access_ready`; a run action that is `cancellable`
centrifuge.label: centrifuge
centrifuge.definition: A device with a rapidly rotating container that applies centrifugal force to its contents

lyophilizer.conventions: `lid_closed`/`door_closed` interlock on the run action; a recipe-driven run that is `cancellable`; watchdog `release`
lyophilizer.label: lyophilizer
lyophilizer.definition: A device that is used to freeze dry material.

rotary_evaporator.conventions: bath temperature, rotation and vacuum each as measured and setpoint; `lid_closed`-style interlock on lowering the flask; a run that is `cancellable`
rotary_evaporator.label: rotary evaporator
rotary_evaporator.definition: A piece of apparatus consisting of a motor unit that rotates the evaporation flask, a vacuum system, a heated water bath and a condenser, which is used to remove solvents from samples under reduced pressure.

reactor.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals; `door_closed`/`lid_closed` as a signal and an interlock where there is one; a recipe-driven run with `returns`
reactor.label: reactor
reactor.definition: A reactor is a container for controlling a biological or chemical reaction or process. [Allotrope]

bioreactor.conventions: the measured value and the setpoint as separate signals per loop; a recipe-driven run with `returns`; `robot_access_ready` where a sampler meets it
bioreactor.label: bioreactor
bioreactor.definition: A device or system that supports a biologically active environment.

cryostat.conventions: temperature and field measured and setpoint as separate signals; `chamber_state` enum; watchdog `release`
cryostat.label: cryostat
cryostat.definition: A device consisting of a vessel, similar in construction to a vacuum flask, that is used to maintain cold cryogenic temperatures. FIX THIS DEFINITION

spin_coater.conventions: a `run_recipe` action with typed steps (speed, acceleration, duration) and `returns`; `lid_closed` and `vacuum_ok` interlocks; `estop` stops the chuck
spin_coater.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

mill.conventions: a `run` action with typed speed and duration and `returns`; `lid_closed` interlock; `estop` stops the drive
mill.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

deposition_system.conventions: `base_pressure`, `process_pressure`, `power`/`power_setpoint`, `shutter_open`, `substrate_temperature` signals; `deposit` with `returns` carrying the thickness estimate; `base_pressure_ok` and `door_closed` interlocks; `hardware_stop: true` where the tool has one
deposition_system.label: sputter coater
deposition_system.definition: A piece of apparatus, consisting of an anode (the specimen) a cathode (the source of sputter atoms or 'target') and a magnet, all held inside a vacuum chamber, which is used to coat specimens with a thin layer of atoms (e.g. Au) prior to microscopy.

3d_printer.conventions: a `print` action taking a file URI whose `returns` names the job; `door_closed` interlock; `estop` disables the heaters
3d_printer.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

cnc.conventions: a `run_program` action taking a file URI; `door_closed` interlock; `estop: true`
cnc.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

laser.conventions: output enable as a boolean setting; `shutter_open` as a signal; `estop` closes the shutter and disables emission
laser.label: laser
laser.definition: A laser (acronym for light amplification by the stimulated emission of radiation) is a light source that emits photons of the same characteristics in a coherent beam. A laser uses a solid, liquid or gaseous lasing medium, that contains molecules, of which some atoms have electrons that emit photons of the same frequency when falling back to their normal orbital after excitation (pumping) by external means A laser is the most common way to irradiate a cell in a flow cytometer.

potentiostat.conventions: output enable as a boolean setting; `estop` disables every output; `returns` on acquisitions names the data file
potentiostat.label: potentiostat
potentiostat.definition: A device that maintains the potential through an electrochemical cell at a preset value.

battery_cycler.conventions: a `channel` parameter on every action; `start_protocol` with typed steps (mode, current, voltage, time limits) and `returns` carrying cycle count and last capacity; `channel_state` signal; `estop` opens every channel
battery_cycler.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

source_meter.conventions: output enable as a boolean setting; `estop` disables every output; `returns` on sweeps names the data file
source_meter.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

lock_in_amplifier.conventions: output enable as a boolean setting; `estop` disables every output; `returns` on acquisitions names the data file
lock_in_amplifier.label: lock-in amplifier
lock_in_amplifier.definition: An amplifier that can increase the power of a signal with a known carrier wave from an extremely noisy environment. A lock-in amplifier uses a frequency mixer to convert the signal's phase and amplitude into a DC voltage signal.

oscilloscope.conventions: an `acquire` action whose `returns` names the waveform file
oscilloscope.label: oscilloscope
oscilloscope.definition: A device that measures and displayes signal voltages, usually as a two-dimensional graph of one or more electrical potential differences (vertical axis) plotted as a function of time or of some other voltage (horizontal axis).

power_supply.conventions: output enable as a boolean setting; `estop` disables every output
power_supply.label: power supply
power_supply.definition: A power supply is an device or part of a device that permits the required application of a defined electrical charge to an instrument. The power supply may permit the defined application of a given amount of current for a defined length of time.

data_acquisition_device.conventions: channels as signals with units; output enable as a boolean setting; `estop` disables every output
data_acquisition_device.label: data acquisition device
data_acquisition_device.definition: A device to acquire signals or data. [Allotrope]

sensor.conventions: measurements as signals with units; `out_of_spec` from the instrument's self-check where it has one
sensor.label: sensor
sensor.definition: A sensor is a component of a measuring system that is directly affected by a phenomenon, body, or substance carrying a quantity to be measured. [Allotrope]

vacuum_gauge.conventions: pressure as a signal in UCUM; `out_of_spec` from the gauge's self-check where it has one
vacuum_gauge.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI

generic.conventions: no convention; name the capabilities plainly and say in `notes` what the device is
generic.propose_to: no published term; propose to the Allotrope Foundation or OBI
